entities.name: Shin Chae-ho
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sin Ch'aeho, or Shin Chae-ho or Sin Chaeho, was a Korean independence activist, historian, anarchist, nationalist, and a founder of Korean nationalist historiography. He is held in high esteem in both North and South Korea.
